title: nxr-colormaps atlas manifest
description: Sidecar JSON for one PNG atlas. One of these files lives next to each colormaps.png under dist/<library>/.

library.description: Library label — 'default' for the curated cross-source palette, otherwise the basename of the corresponding libraries/<name>.toml.

rows.description: Number of colormaps in this atlas (= PNG height).

colormaps.description: Per-row metadata, in PNG row order.

name.description: Public colormap name; unique within this atlas.

source.description: Source adapter kind that produced the row.

source_id.description: Identifier within the source: registry key for matplotlib/colorcet, attribute name for cmocean/crameri, relative CSV path for raw.

perceptually_uniform.description: True if luminance is monotonic / balanced.

description.description: Free-form usage hint (may surface in picker UIs).

citation.description: Author / paper attribution for this specific colormap. Empty when not specified. The library-wide license is in the `license` field instead.

index.description: Row index in this PNG (0-based, local to the file).

license.description: Library-wide license attribution. Identical for every entry from the same source kind.

preview.description: CSS `linear-gradient(90deg, …)` with 12 evenly-spaced rgb() stops sampled from this colormap's atlas row — the swatch a picker renders without decoding the PNG. Emitted by the baker itself (no separate post-process step).
